papers.title: Particle-scale insights into sand deformation during open-ended pile installation using DIC and X-ray CT
papers.authors: Fridman DG, Stamati O et al.
papers.abstract: This paper presents the results from two model open-ended pipe pile installations in sand and subsequent particle-scale analysis using X-ray computed tomography. The experiments were performed in a large half-cylindrical calibration chamber with imaging capabilities. During testing, digital images were captured and later analysed using digital image correlation (DIC) to obtain displacement and strain fields in the sand domain. After installation, sand around, below and inside the pile was impregnated using an epoxy resin. The epoxy-impregnated samples collected from the calibration chamber were scanned using X-ray computed tomography and, from the reconstructed three-dimensional (3D) volumes, the sand fabric was determined. Kinematics obtained from two-dimensional (2D) DIC analyses of…
papers.angle: Particle-scale imaging of sand around open-ended piles clarifies plugging and displacement mechanisms, offering evidence to refine installation and capacity design assumptions for pile engineers.
